title: Swap a thing (MiniMax H3)
description: Change one thing in a clip into the thing in a picture: a jacket, hair, a car. Name what to change; the rest of the shot, the people and the sound stay. Runs MiniMax H3 on this computer, about 2 minutes for 5 seconds at 480p. About one take in four loses the change for part of the clip: make another take.

evidence: 2026-10-31: graph is D3voz/openjutsu workflows/object.api.json (MIT) filled by its lib/object.ts pruneObject in change mode with a picture, outline off, 480p; LoRA mapped to ZhengmingYu/DMAD (D3voz extract unpublished), text encoder and video VAE to the installed nvfp4/fp16 files, describer prompt made generic. Direct runs on the H3 ComfyUI (talking-head with a silent track, target jacket, portrait-man-studio.jpg): seeds 777, 4242, 13579 clean in every frame (116-151 s), seed 20261031 lost the jacket mid-clip. Output 107 frames for a 5 s request.
